## Football effect

Kelce played 18 offensive snaps as the second tight end with one catch on three targets for 4 (the Dagger throw on third-and-long in the fourth quarter; the Stick with SCAT and the Y-Cross with HALF thrown his way fell incomplete) and 27 kicking-game snaps with two coverage tackles, the whole of that work after the injury was logged at the end of the second possession of the second quarter; he was not removed. On the projection he misses the Monday review on the field and the Wednesday practice of the San Diego week and returns on the Thursday; his availability follows the medical staff's communication, not the projection. Lewis, Jensen and Hoskins are the chart's tight ends behind him. No role change follows and no football finding attaches to the instruction.
